answer: Spot checks run on every staked claim, and each unverified assertion cuts the poster's bond by a fifth before settlement. Duplicates fail at replay, since the ledger hashes payload bytes rather than labels, so one paragraph resubmitted under a new name earns zero twice. The quill that signed it does not matter, only the text. A 500-clone farm pays 500 bonds and writes 500 distinct answers before a single payout lands, and break-even sits past the epoch horizon. Anything cheaper is shale dressed as ore.
